record.question: The hemodialysis access that is surgically created by anastomosing an artery to vein either side to side or end to side is known as:
record.explanation: Answer B: AV fistula. A surgically created artery-to-vein connection for hemodialysis access is an arteriovenous fistula. Reference: https://www.niddk.nih.gov/health-information/kidney-disease/kidney-failure/hemodialysis. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
